_comment: Sweep knobs, docs/CONTRACTS.md section 32: six opt-in surface settings,
one per long-task hypothesis, so an adaptive benchmark sweep can test each
as a change to the hashed surface. Absent, or declared at its default,
every request body is byte-identical to master's at ae17a1ae
(sweep_knobs.test.ts pins the hashes, taken before the code existed).
sweep_knobs.test.ts holds the code's lists and defaults (sweep_knobs.ts)
to this file, and checks every record field below against a scripted run;
docs.test.ts holds CONTRACTS.md section 32 to the keys and values.

reasoning_effort.precedence: the role's declaration, else the endpoint's; "provider" or a value outside the list sends none

sampling.precedence: sampling = "provider" on the endpoint omits both whatever the role declares; a role's temperature or top_p = "provider" omits that one

env_snapshot.records: counters.bootstrap and audit kind bootstrap (section 19), with id env_snapshot

wire.reasoning_effort: the effort sent, present only when one was
wire.sampling_omitted: the sampling fields not sent, present only when one was left out

counters.edit_match: {exact, whitespace, indentation}: on every turn under variant = "compat"
counters.package_index: {admitted, hosts}: on every turn of a network = false surface that lists hosts
